verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Bugbot as analyzing PR diffs and using prior PR comments as context. Nothing documents it reading call sites, related modules, or inferring conventions from the wider repository. The `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` guidelines and learned rules are user-supplied or rule-based review configuration, an adjacent control rather than whole-repository understanding. Higher effort levels make reviews deeper but are not shown to add repository context.

support.subject: As a developer, review comments reflect the whole repository — call sites, related modules, existing conventions — not just the changed hunks
